_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Named breaker is live post-FOMC drift overlapping opex with extreme exchange_netflow/reserves/skew and dead etf_flows; coil base rate keeps conviction low because a ~1% event move often fails to clear a full rung.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls Anxiety/DOWN/SHORT; narrative is silent on BTC forward phase and only covers energy vs metals flows
next_move.confirmed_if: Opex-day close below 79700 with funding rolling over and exchange_netflow still extreme while etf_flows stay dead
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC accepts and holds above 80000 with etf_flows lifting off 1 and options_skew backing off 100
